💥Make sure you don't rush the story and actually take time to build up Jason and Lucia’s relationship, because keeping their bond high improves their teamwork in combat, unlocks special couple interactions, and is essential for getting the good ending! You can summon each other anytime via text or leave your safehouse together to do tons of fun, crime-free activities like strolling through shopping malls, holding hands on the beach, playing mini-golf or basketball, kayaking, scuba diving, visiting Wildland Zoo, petting stray cats and dogs, and meditating at scenic spots. Also, try to focus on heroic acts and helping locals instead of reckless crimes to boost their respect and steer them toward the best ending, and make sure to hit the gym together regularly (followed by protein shakes and showering) so both of them gain Strength and Cardio stats at the same time just remember to wait until Chapter 2 to start seriously grinding money, deposit your cash at ATMs so you don't lose it, and avoid putting everything into the one-way Family Savings account!     ✨✨✨
Plus, if you want to earn good money without committing crimes, you can compete in repeatable dirt and track races (like the Ambrosia Raceway derby for $3,800–$6,300 per win), run timed package delivery jobs ($12,000–$20,000), go scuba diving with Kenton to recover sunken treasure, hunt large game for Killtelligence Provisions, or stop street thieves and return stolen items to locals in random heroic encounters!
